# R011 — First-century Periplus port descriptions

The Periplus describes Muziris and neighbouring ports, rulers and maritime exchange in sections 53–56. The inspected edition places the ancient composition in the first century CE.

**Evidence type:** `primary_text_in_translation`  
**Geographic relation:** `external_reference`  
**Places:** Muziris: precise modern location disputed; Southwestern Indian ports

## Limitations

Do not equate every ancient place name with a modern coordinate or infer the ethnicity of all residents from trade. Pliny (Natural History 6.26) describes Muziris as not very rich in merchandise, which differs from the Periplus account; the difference is unresolved.
